verdict.rationale: Together AI publishes a first-party Deprecations page describing a structured model lifecycle policy covering upgrades, redirects, and deprecation schedules. The only concrete notice period in the evidence is a 3-day notice before an endpoint redirects to an upgraded version. Nothing shows a stated advance-notice window before a hosted model is actually removed. missing for 10: a documented notice period specifically for model removal, evidence that the advance notice is substantial rather than 3 days, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is followed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed

citations.quote: Together AI follows a structured approach to introducing new models, upgrading existing models, and deprecating older versions, so you can rely on predictable behavior.
The current endpoint redirects to the upgraded version after a 3-day notice.
